hero.heading:
Saint Maron Church
Maronite Catholic
hero.eyebrow: Est. 1892 · Eparchy of Saint Maron of Brooklyn
hero.lede:
One of the first Maronite parishes in North America, Saint Maron Church has faithfully served the faithful in South Philadelphia since 1892. For generations, our parish has been a home of prayer, worship, and communion, preserving and sharing the rich spiritual heritage of the Maronite Catholic Church.

On Saturday, December 2, 2017, we gave thanks to God as we celebrated the 125th anniversary of our parish. We remember with gratitude all those who, through their faith, sacrifice, and devotion, helped build the parish we cherish today.

Rooted in the faith of our fathers and strengthened by the grace of God, Saint Maron continues its mission of proclaiming the Gospel and celebrating the Sacred Mysteries. All are welcome at the Table of the Lord.

parish.heading: Saint Jude Novena (October 20-28)
parish.story: This year, during our Saint Jude Novena, we will reflect on the seven virtues. These virtues are good habits that help us choose what is right, grow in holiness, and become more Christ-like in our daily lives. They shape the way we think, act, and respond to God and to one another. May this novena be a time of prayer, reflection, and spiritual growth for us all.

sections.heading: Annual Thanksgiving Food Drive
sections.text:
Every year, we come together to support those in need and help make Thanksgiving a little brighter for individuals and families. We are proud to continue this tradition by providing Thanksgiving meals to those who may need a helping hand, extending our support beyond our immediate community.

We are excited to announce that our 2026 Thanksgiving Food Drive will run from October 25 through November 15, 2026!

Your support, generosity, and kindness can make a meaningful difference in someone’s life this holiday season. Together, we can help ensure that more individuals and families have a warm meal and a reason to be thankful.

Let’s spread kindness, share blessings, and make this Thanksgiving special for everyone. Every contribution counts!

Thank you for supporting our mission and helping us make a difference, one meal at a time.
